name: Amend Non Deliverable Forward Opening V 02
definition: Scope|The AmendNonDeliverableForwardOpening message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to notify the amendment of the opening of a non deliverable trade previously confirmed by the sender.|Usage|The message is sent from a participant to a central settlement system to advise of the update of a previously sent notification and it contains a "Related Reference" to link it to the previous notification.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides references and date of the non deliverable trade which is amended.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the non deliverable trade which is amended.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the non deliverable trade which is amended.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the non deliverable trade which is amended.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Specifies the rate of the non deliverable trade which is amended.

ValuationConditions.name: Valuation Conditions
ValuationConditions.definition: Specifies the valuation conditions of the non deliverable trade which is amended.
